description: Architecting enterprise BI migration platform converting Tableau Prep workflows into distributed DAG-based ETL pipelines. Built FastAPI orchestration service achieving <5s API response time. Engineered OpenAI-based fallback execution engine. Reduced AI Claims Adjudication response time from 25s → 10s.

Designed and built Django-based multi-tenant backend deployed across 10–12 international markets for the PepIris retail CV platform. Automated ML model deployment pipeline, reduced QA validation cycle by 90%+. Migrated legacy Pandas pipelines to PySpark on Azure Databricks.

Developed Django REST APIs for analytics, KPI retrieval, and reporting. Designed SQL Server schema for scalable multi-market architecture. Built ETL pipelines using Pandas and SQLAlchemy, implemented API versioning, optimised database connection pooling.

Built Model Builder ML training platform (React + Flask) integrating H2O.ai AutoML, XGBoost, LightGBM and Airflow DAGs. Developed Scenario Builder forecasting platform with Databricks Hive and GCP backends.
